        self.client._opener.open.return_value = io.BytesIO(b'private invalid response')
        with self.assertRaises(openai_client.OpenAIError):
            self.client.create_response('private', model='test')

        self.client._opener.open.side_effect = error.URLError('secret')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(openai_client.OpenAIError, 'transport error'):
            self.client.create_response('private', model='test')

        for result in [
            {'status': 'incomplete', 'output': []},
            {'status': 'completed', 'output': [{'type': 'message', 'role': 'assistant', 'content': [{'type': 'refusal', 'refusal': 'private'}]}]},
            {'status': 'completed', 'output': []},
            {'status': 'failed', 'error': {'message': 'private'}},
        ]:
            with self.subTest(result=result):
                self.reply(result)
                with self.assertRaises(openai_client.OpenAIError):
                    self.client.send_prompt('private', model='test')

        for timeout in [0, -1, float('inf'), float('nan'), True, '60']:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

        handler = openai_client._NoRedirect()
        self.assertIsNone(handler.redirect_request(None, None, 302, '', {}, 'https://example.com'))
